Software Engineer - Himmah Program
Mozn
Riyadh
Full-time
Full job description
About Mozn

MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.

We’re a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact.

If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises.

About the role
We are seeking a talented Software Engineer to join our AI-focused company. In this role, you will design and deliver scalable applications and platforms that power our AI-driven solutions. You will play a key role in building robust systems that integrate data, machine learning, and user interfaces to meet the needs of public and private sector clients in Saudi Arabia.

What you'll do

Developing and maintaining full stack applications with strong front-end and back-end capabilities
Designing user-friendly interfaces and integrate them with AI-powered back-end services
Collaborating with data scientists, ML engineers, and stakeholders to embed AI solutions into software products
Ensuring software systems are secure, scalable, and compliant with local regulations (e.g., PDPL)
Contributing to API development, microservices architecture, and seamless data/model integration
Supporting consultation projects by tailoring software solutions to client requirements
Leading best practices in coding standards, testing, and CI/CD pipelines
Mentoring junior engineers and contribute to continuous improvement of engineering practices
Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
Experience working in Saudi Arabia, delivering consultation services to public and private sector clients
Proficiency in modern front-end frameworks (React, Angular, Vue, etc) and back-end frameworks (Node.js, Django, etc)
Strong skills in JavaScript/TypeScript, and Python
Knowledge of microservices, APIs, and cloud-native development
Familiarity with AI/ML solution integration is a strong plus
Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD, and containerization
Benefits

You will be at the forefront of an exciting time for the Middle East, joining a high-growth rocket-ship in an exciting space
You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best
The fundamentals will be taken care of: competitive compensation, top-tier health insurance, and an enabling culture so that you can focus on what you do best
You will enjoy a fun and dynamic workplace working alongside some of the greatest minds in AI
We believe strength lies in difference, embracing all for who they are and empowered to be the best version of themselves
